All eight official destinations returned HTTP 200. Truth, comparison, constraint, uniqueness, aggregate, IN, and null-safe-operator claims are scoped by context, dialect, and version.

evidence: Recomputed all nine AND and nine OR entries and all three NOT entries over T,F,U.
Recomputed score>7 as T,U,F,F and WHERE survivors as id 1; negated survivors as ids 3 and 4; explicit-null inclusion as ids 1 and 2.

evidence: Re-derived strong three-valued conjunction and disjunction from forced truth/falsehood under incomplete information.

evidence: Validated WHERE retains only T and therefore p and NOT p omit unknown rows.

The verifier matched exact ten-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status.

Separated storage null from JSON omission/explicit null and semantic proof from index/plan evidence.
